{{Quote|In the meantime, we can assume that the bomb that stuck us here also sent out a signal to whoever planted it. Meaning they'll be coming soon. If it was a hyperspace communication and they were signaling the ''Implacable'', the Star Destroyer could be here in another couple of hours. We could make a blind jump to deep space or the nearest star to get away from them, but that'll probably end up killing us; we don't have enough fuel to do any significant exploration. Anybody have any ideas?|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to [[Wraith Squadron]]|<ref name="Wraith" />}}
The '''Ambush at Xobome 6''' was an event during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; where the modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']], a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that belonged to [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces, was ambushed and captured by [[Wraith Squadron]] in the [[Xobome system/Legends|Xobome system]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Demolitions.''"<br />"''Yes, Control.''"<br />"''What do you think hit us?|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Kell Tainer]]|<ref name="Wraith" />}}
After escaping from the [[Battle of Folor]], [[Wraith Squadron]] and the [[Narra (shuttle)|''Narra'']] jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] en route to [[Doldrums]], where they planned to reunite with the other evacuees. However, they were pulled out of hyperspace by [[Empion mine]]s deposited by a support [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Apwar Trigit]]. The mines shorted out their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. It also erased all of their navigational data, which prevented them from leaving the system. Faced with this dilemma, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ordered the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to land on [[Xobome 6]] to make repairs.<ref name="Wraith" />

==The Ambush==
{{Quote|Yes, sir. I think this plan is marginally better than dying of asphyxiation or starvation out in empty space, and it has the virtue of novelty. ''Implacable'' couldn't anticipate we'd do it. Only crazy people could anticipate we'd do it.|[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] agreeing to the plan|<ref name="Wraith" />}}
Surmising that the ship would return once again to check its trap, the Wraiths managed to convince [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] that they could board the enemy ship by using parts from the broken [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Cubber Daine]] constructed a small vessel they named the ''[[Lunatic]]'' out of [[Ton Phanan]]'s damaged X-wing. They outfitted it with thrusters, a stripped down [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to help the navigation. Their plan was to hide a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] inside the [[Smuggling compartment/Legends|smuggling compartment]] and have the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ship tractor it in. Once inside, the pilot would access one of the ship's terminals and send a rescue request to the New Republic. [[Voort saBinring]] volunteered to the be intruder due to his [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] physiology, which would better insulate him from the cold.<ref name="Wraith" />

The enemy ship that appeared turned out to be a modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]], designated [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]. It towed the ''Lunatic'' into its hold while also launching a pair of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] to scout the area. The other Wraiths were lying in wait on a nearby asteroid field where they easily destroyed both TIE's. Aboard the ''Night Caller'', saBinring emerged from the smuggling compartment and managed to subdue the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] guarding the area. He then fired his cannon into the hold ceiling and climbed his way to the ship's bridge; where he demanded and received the bridge crew's surrender. He later learned that the ship's captain, [[Zurel Darillian]] was killed by the shot he made to the ceiling.<ref name="Wraith" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Captain Voort saBinring of the New Republic corvette ''Night Caller'' hailing Wraith Squadron. Wraith Squadron, come in.|[[Voort saBinring]] after capturing the ''Night Caller''|<ref name="Wraith" />}}
Due to the quick capture of the ''Night Caller'', the ship's crew were not able to send a distress signal. This meant that Zsinj's forces were not aware of the ship's capture. Based on this, Antilles decided on his own initiative that they would pretend to be the ship's crew and perform all it's missions with the intent of finding a way to deal a critical blow to Zsinj.<ref name="Wraith" />
